import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 133

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture133

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 133](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/):

For a simple connected graph $G$,
$\operatorname{path}(G) \ge \operatorname{rad}(G) +
\lfloor \mathrm{avg}_v\, l(v) \rfloor^{cC_4(G)}$,
where $\operatorname{path}(G)$ is the path number of the graph (number of vertices of a largest induced path),
$\operatorname{rad}(G)$ is the radius (minimum eccentricity, as a natural number),
$\mathrm{avg}_v\, l(v) = l(G)$ is the average independence number of vertex
neighbourhoods, and $cC_4(G)$ is the $C_4$-free characteristic function
(1 if $G$ is $C_4$-free, not necessarily induced, and 0 otherwise).

We read DeLaVina's bracket notation `[average of λ(v)]` in the source as the
floor (a standard Graffiti.pc convention), hence `⌊l G⌋` in Lean.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture133 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let rad := G.radius.toNat
    let hasC4 := ∃ a b c d : α, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d ∧
      G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a
    let cC4 : ℕ := if hasC4 then 0 else 1
    (rad : ℝ) + (⌊l G⌋ : ℝ) ^ cC4 ≤ (path G : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The `path G` invariant is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ (path G : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- `radius` toNat is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ G.radius.toNat := Nat.zero_le _

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture133

findings.description: Line 53 introduces a floor that is not present in the source: `(⌊l G⌋ : ℝ) ^ cC4` should use the unrounded average. For C₄-free graphs, the source asserts `radius + l G ≤ path`, equivalently `radius + ⌈l G⌉ ≤ path`, whereas Lean asserts `radius + ⌊l G⌋ ≤ path`. Integrality does not justify this change. For example, Lean verifies that the connected C₄-free graph P₃ has radius 1 and average local independence 4/3: the source gives the lower bound 7/3, requiring at least 3 vertices, while Lean gives only 2. P₃ illustrates the different bounds; it is not a counterexample to either conjecture.
findings.source_evidence: DeLaVina’s WOWII entry 133 states `path(G) ≥ rad(G)+ [average of λ(v)]^χC4`, with definition links 35, 13, 4, and 73: https://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html . The source uses these brackets for grouping; its separately defined rounding notation is explicitly `FLOOR[x]` (definition 22), and conjectures such as 19 and 20 explicitly write FLOOR and link definition 22. Conjecture 133 neither writes FLOOR nor links that definition, despite having a spare definition slot. See https://web.archive.org/web/20240726225301id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowii/wowIIdefs.js , definitions 4, 16, and 22.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the final inequality with `(rad : ℝ) + (l G) ^ cC4 ≤ (path G : ℝ)`. Remove the floor from the theorem docstring and remove the assertion that bare brackets denote floor by a Graffiti.pc convention.

reformulations.difference: The source uses the C₄-free characteristic function, while Lean defines it through four pairwise-distinct vertices with cyclic adjacencies, without forbidding chords.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Such vertices give the closed walk a–b–c–d–a, which is a cycle of length four. Conversely, a cycle of length four has four distinct successive vertices satisfying exactly these inequalities and adjacencies. Additional chords do not matter, matching source definition 73: C₄-free means excluding C₄ as a not-necessarily-induced subgraph. The equivalence with `∃ a, ∃ p : G.Walk a a, p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = 4` was proved in /workspace/review/cycle_iff.lean.

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, conjecture 133 and surrounding remarks; also entries 19–20 for rounding notation: https://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html
Archived landing page of the cited reference: https://web.archive.org/web/20260807053017id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/
Local repository guidance: STATEMENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and FormalConjectures/WrittenOnTheWallII/README.md.

Local invariant definitions: FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/{VertexDistance,Independence,Eccentricity,Connectivity}.lean; relevant Mathlib definitions in SimpleGraph/{Diam,Metric,Clique,Maps,Paths,Connectivity/Connected}.lean and Data/ENat/Basic.lean.
Historical calibration: /workspace/past_misformalizations/INDEX.md and pr01256.md, pr04171.md, pr02295.md, pr04103.md.
review.notes: Both anonymous sanity checks are correct. Finite connectedness ensures `G.radius ≠ ⊤`, so `radius.toNat` preserves the radius. The path and local-independence definitions have the intended semantics; empty and singleton cases introduce no additional defect. Scratch checks cover these boundaries, K₂, P₃, and the C₄ condition on K₃ and K₄. /workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/cycle_iff.lean compile cleanly without using the conjecture. The live reference was unavailable, so archived primary-source pages were used; the July 2026 conjecture list marks 133 'O', matching `research open`. No repository source files were edited, and the target matches the specified commit.

submission.summary: Replaced the floored average with the unrounded `l G` in the inequality. Updated the docstring and removed the incorrect floor-convention claim, leaving other declarations and attributes unchanged. The required compile command succeeds with only the permitted `declaration uses 'sorry'` warning.
